name: Free film pack
note: Public-domain film clips for Morph: Your clips. Nothing here is shipped: Setup & models pulls each window straight from archive.org with ffmpeg (a byte-range read of the source, a few MB a clip) into work/ui/film_pack/, and writes a CREDITS.md beside the clips. A source marked whole is downloaded in full first (small files whose container cannot be read over HTTP). Times are seconds in the source file. A source with crop (w:h:x:y) has black bars baked into its frame; they are cut off. The clips are in the order a clips cut plays them.
